idea-plugin.name: Tree Shade
idea-plugin.description:
Tree Shade keeps Rider's File System and Solution explorers focused on the files that matter.

Hide noisy folders and files by name (for example bin, obj, lib, .vscode, .idea, and .DS_Store), with remaining entries sorted folders-first, then alphabetically.

Configure per project under Settings | Tools | Tree Shade.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Hide folders and files by name in Rider’s File System and Solution explorers
  • Per-project settings under Settings → Tools → Tree Shade
  • Folders-first sorting for remaining tree entries
  • Sensible defaults (bin, obj, lib, .vscode, .idea, .DS_Store)
  • File System tree now updates when files are added or removed
